thread:
nik: quick idea from today's postmortem: our golden set is great for correctness but too narrow for sampling-heavy models. proposing a 'golden amplification' pass that expands seeds deterministically to stress sampler behavior across runtimes.

maria_v: curious, how do you expand without blowing up runtime cost?

nik: two parts: (A) deterministic perturbations of existing golden prompts (token-level insertions, trailing punctuation, special-token prefixes), (B) low-cost seed sweep with fixed random seeds (e.g., 8 seeds) and minimal top-k sampling. aggregate metrics only.

bench-bot: I can implement the pass. cost estimate: extra ~30s per model if we limit to 48 perturbed prompts and reuse warmed containers. outputs will be canonicalized and sampled deterministically for given seeds.

ram: what's the failure criteria? small KL divergence tolerable, but there should be thresholds for token-drop and prefix-preservation.

nik: agree. propose hard fail if deterministic prefix (first N tokens) diverges or special-token mapping differs. soft warn if sample-distribution KL > 0.2 or token-bleu < 0.85 across seeds.

maria_v: we need to consider quantized runtimes separately. quantized can trigger 'restricted' tag rather than block overall onboarding.

devops_bot: console UX note: if a model gets restricted, add a quick action to request a manual "quantization review" which queues a hands-on run and assigns it to infra-ml oncall.

bench-bot: serializer rules for diffs: NFKC normalize, strip zero-width chars, collapse whitespace, round logits to 4 decimals, and produce token-id sequences plus text for easier triage.

zoe: telemetry hook idea: when a model is restricted we should auto-enable a short canary for teams that opt-in to quant variants: route 0.2% traffic for 48h and capture token-shift histogram + user-perceived metrics.

ram: good. also add a fallback routing rule: if quantized variant breaks in prod, auto-fallback to fp32 with a circuit-breaker and alert.

nik: implementation checklist I'll add to the RFC follow-up: (1) bench-bot "golden-amplify" job, (2) thresholds and serializer spec, (3) restricted-tag semantics + console actions, (4) quant-canary policy + runbook, (5) telemetry counters to show token-shift histograms. posting PR later today.

maria_v: thanks. can we also surface a compact token-diff snippet in the ingest UI so teams can triage quickly?

bench-bot: yup I can include a one-line token-diff summary and a link to full artifact.

nik: tagging followups: @bench-bot for job impl, @zoe for canary telemetry, @devops_bot for console actions. will drop the PR link in #eng-ml once ready.
